screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind trial of aminophylline (theophylline analogue) versus placebo in patients with acute ischaemic stroke; treatment initiated in the acute hospitalization period (within one week implied). Meets population, intervention, comparator, and timing.
Randomized double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of intravenous aminophylline in acute cerebral infarction (acute ischaemic stroke), treatment given in acute phase. Meets PICOT criteria.
Open-label, single-arm dose-escalation (no randomized comparator). Not a randomized controlled trial.
Study of vincamine with small aminophylline subgroup; population not specified as acute ischaemic stroke and randomization unclear. Does not meet randomized RCT in acute stroke within one week.
Randomized cross-over physiological study in patients recovering from acute ischaemic stroke, not within one week of onset; not an acute treatment RCT versus placebo/control.
Randomized cross-over physiological study in stroke patients recovering (not within one week). Not a randomized acute treatment trial meeting timing criteria.
Physiologic study of intracarotid aminophylline effects on cerebral blood flow; population not defined as acute ischaemic stroke and no randomized comparator.
Animal study in cats; not a randomized clinical trial in humans with acute ischaemic stroke.
Animal study in dogs; not a randomized clinical trial in humans with acute ischaemic stroke.
Mechanistic/observational discussion; lacks randomized controlled design in acute ischaemic stroke.
